name: Worg Warrior 2 (d20pfsrd)
body:
Worg Warrior 2
CR 3

XP 800
Male worg warrior 2
NE Medium magical beast
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 45 (6d10+12)
Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +8 (1d6+3 plus trip)

TACTICS

Before Combat If the PCs are helping rid the monastery of monsters, they must make Sense Motives checks, opposed by the worg’s Bluff, to act in the surprise round when he attacks them.

During Combat The worg singles out the weak in any combat situation, targeting spellcasters first. He uses Power Attack when attacking such foes. He does not attack prone foes unless he has no other choice or they try to stand.

Morale The worg will fight to the death to protect his home.

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 17, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +6; CMB +8; CMD 19 (23 vs. trip)
Feats Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Bluff +5, Intimidate +4, Perception +7, Stealth +6, Survival +3
Racial Modifiers +2 Perception, +2 Stealth, +2 Survival
Languages Common, Goblin
